race.comment: WAYBURN (1) stretches out to this trip for the first time after he savaged the line when a month between runs to finish sixth to Lord Remlap over 1200m at Randwick last Saturday. Has solid top three prospects. XTREME (9) progressive gelding who doesn't have to improve much to win this. Tough again second up when he powered late for a game third over 1400m at this track. Key jockey change and can race close. Hard to hold out. BRUTAL MISS (15) progressing well and relished the extra trip with a narrow win over 1400m at the Gold Coast in C1 class. Returned solid figures on that occasion and looks up to this. I AM STEFFI (14) keeps raising the bar on the country tracks and has earned her shot in town after winning at her last three starts. Will push forward and give plenty of cheek. NIMBLE STAR (6) raced without luck in this grade in his three runs back and keep safe over the extra ground.
